resources.string: A 1-minute pullback entry checker using EMA 7/25/99, RSI, MACD, volume, and price action. It reads public candles and never places trades.

The 1-minute chart is the primary analysis timeframe. The app plots the latest 100 completed 1-minute candles with EMA 7, EMA 25, and EMA 99 overlays. It identifies aligned uptrends and downtrends, waits for a pullback against the trend, then checks for the trend-side trigger. RSI, MACD momentum, and volume must provide at least two confirmations, and the combined point score must meet the selected strictness level. An uptrend dip produces a BUY THE DIP prompt. A rally inside a downtrend produces a BUY THE RETRACEMENT prompt as requested; this is countertrend and carries greater reversal risk. This is a manual decision aid, not financial advice or an automatic trader.
